prompt_text: Who is the best health insurance broker in Kansas City to help me pick a plan?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” broker, but **AIS Health Insurance Advisors** looks like a good first call if you’re shopping for individual or family coverage in the Kansas City area. They say they compare ACA Marketplace and other plans across Kansas and Missouri, and don’t charge you a fee. **Call 913-333-8627** or visit [aishealthadvisors.com](https://aishealthadvisors.com/).

You could also compare them with **BBS Insurance** (816-205-4664; [bbs-insurance.com](https://bbs-insurance.com/)) or **Apollo Health Insurance** (816-400-4477; [apollo-insurance.com](https://apollo-insurance.com/)). Both describe themselves as independent, no-cost brokers serving the metro.

Before enrolling, ask each broker which insurers and plans they can actually quote in your county, whether they’ll check your Marketplace subsidy eligibility, and how your doctors and prescriptions are covered. Broker commissions can vary, so compare the recommendation with [HealthCare.gov](https://www.healthcare.gov/) and verify the agent’s license with the [Kansas Insurance Department](https://www.insurance.kansas.gov/licensing).
